verdict.rationale: Adyen lets merchants build their own custom risk rules. The risk evaluation then automatically takes an action: block, allow, review, or 3DS routing. This is a direct rule-to-action capability, but it is limited to payment transactions and a fixed set of risk actions rather than general event-driven automation. Missing for 10: rule triggers beyond payment risk evaluation, configurable action types beyond block/allow/review/3DS, detailed docs on rule conditions and syntax, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
